name: Addon Control Panel
description_text: Addon Control Panel (ACP) adds an AddOns button to the game menu so you can enable or disable AddOns and reload the UI without logging out.

name: Talented
description_text: Talented replaces the default talent window with an expanded talent interface.

name: Critline
description_text: Critline records your highest hits, critical strikes, heals and pet attacks. It includes record tooltips, filters, a standalone window and alerts for new records.

name: GearScore
description_text:
GearScore calculates a score from a player's equipped items to give a quick overview of their gear.

GearScoreLite: Reborn: An updated version of GearScoreLite with an improved scoring algorithm, bug fixes and support for unit-frame AddOns. It does not keep a player database.
GearScore Lite: A lightweight version without a player database, including fixes for talent inspection.
GearScore: Stores player gear information in a database so you can view it later.

name: AtlasLoot Enhanced
description_text: AtlasLoot Enhanced lets you browse boss loot tables from within the game.

name: DBM Deadly Boss Mods Warmane
description_text: Deadly Boss Mods (DBM) is a popular addon that assists players in tracking and reacting to the many boss mechanics one might encounter during a dungeon or raid.

source.label: How to install for the first time

name: Skada vs. Details!
description_text:
Skada is the recommended choice for WotLK 3.3.5a. Both AddOns track damage, healing and other combat stats, but the current Details! port can use more CPU and memory, making Skada the better option for performance.

⚠️ Use only one damage meter at a time.

name: Omen Threat Meter
description_text: Omen displays threat levels so you can see which players are most likely to draw enemy attacks.

name: TurnIn
description_text: TurnIn automates quest acceptance, quest turn-ins and selected NPC dialogue options. Open its options with /ti window.

name: Questie
description_text: Questie displays quest objectives, NPCs and items on the map and adds helpful quest information to tooltips, making it easier to find and complete quests.

name: Zygor Guides
description_text: Zygor Guides Viewer Remaster is a modernized version of the classic Zygor Guides Viewer, built specifically for World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King (3.3.5a / build 12340) private servers. It preserves the original 3.3.5a guide engine, step system, and waypoint workflow while introducing a cleaner, retail-inspired UI, an improved Guide Manager, updated arrow and objective styling, accessibility options (including colorblind presets), and ongoing compatibility support for WotLK 3.3.5a environments. The addon includes step-by-step leveling guidance, waypoint navigation, structured quest flow, and an integrated Talent Advisor - all packaged in a remastered, streamlined viewer designed for long play sessions.

name: Questhelper
description_text: QuestHelper uses a database of quests, NPCs and items to show where your objectives are and plan efficient routes between them.

name: EveryQuest
description_text: EveryQuest tracks your quest history and provides a searchable quest-list window.

name: Carbonite (Maps / QuestHelper)
description_text: Carbonite replaces the world map with a Google Maps-style interface and includes quest-tracking tools.

name: Mapster
description_text: Mapster improves the world map and is designed to work alongside other map AddOns.

name: Cartographer
description_text: Cartographer provides a modular framework for customizing and extending the world map.

name: Cromulent
description_text: Cromulent displays zone information directly on the world map.

name: Gatherer+
description_text: Gatherer+ remembers where you have gathered herbs, mined ore or opened containers and records those locations on the map. Open it with /gather.

name: pMinimap
description_text: pMinimap is a very lightweight and streamlined Minimap addon.

name: CleanMinimap
description_text: A clean square or round minimap that replaces the default minimap.

name: SexyMap
description_text: SexyMap customizes the minimap with a selection of predefined visual styles.

name: pretty_minimap
description_text: pretty_minimap is a lightweight minimap AddOn with a Dragonflight-style appearance.

name: Auctionator (Cata Port Version)
description_text: Auctionator simplifies browsing, buying and selling at the Auction House, with clearer listings and easier auction management. This is the Cataclysm-port version for WotLK.

name: TradeSkillMaster
description_text: TradeSkillMaster is an all-in-one suite for the in-game economy, backported to WotLK 3.3.5a. It includes auction-house scanning and bulk posting, crafting and profit management, item groups and operations, mailing, banking, vendoring, and accounting.

name: DalaranAH
description_text: DalaranAH adds a customizable button for the Auction House NPC in Dalaran. Use it to target, focus or mark the NPC and open the Auction House without manually selecting the dialogue option.

name: Emblem of Gold V2
description_text: Emblem of Gold is a simple World of Warcraft addon that shows your gold and emblem counts (Heroism, Valor, Conquest, Triumph, Frost) when you open a vendor.

name: Chatter
description_text: Chatter customizes the chat interface with options such as class-colored names, timestamps, fonts, chat-copying tools and URL copying.

name: BNetToast
description_text: BNetToast shows Battle.net-style online and offline notifications for friends and guild members.

name: ChatFilter (project abandoned)
description_text:
ChatFilter hides messages containing words from a configurable blacklist in say, yell and global chat. Edit the blacklist in game to filter unwanted messages.

⚠️ Project abandoned — works but no longer updated.

name: STFU: Shut the fuck up, thanks.
description_text: Efficiently blocks all opposite-faction chat spam in neutral cities (Dalaran, Shattrath, etc) and other neutral areas. Still shows their messages if you are outside of neutral zones, to preserve situational awareness of nearby enemies.

name: Friend & Ignore Share
description_text: Friend & Ignore Share shares your friend and ignore lists across characters on the same account.

name: IgnoreMore
description_text: IgnoreMore expands the ignore list beyond the default limit and shares it between characters. It also records when players were ignored and the reasons for ignoring them.

name: WIM (WoW Instant Messenger)
description_text: WIM displays whispers in separate instant-messenger-style windows.

name: AddFriend
description_text: AddFriend adds Add Friend and Add Guild options to player context menus.

name: SpellID
description_text: Adds IDs to in-game tooltips.

name: AmILockedOut
description_text: AmILockedOut tracks which of your characters are saved to each instance, helping you keep track of raid and dungeon lockouts.

name: SavedInstances
description_text: SavedInstances tracks raid and instance lockouts across all your characters. Hover over its minimap or Data Broker icon to quickly see which characters are saved to which instances, making it a lightweight alternative to AmILockedOut.

name: KRU - Kader's Raid Utilities
description_text: KRU is a standalone collection of eight raid-utility modules originally included in KPack.

name: WeakAuras
description_text: WeakAuras lets you create customizable displays for buffs, debuffs, cooldowns and other combat information. Use icons, bars, text, sounds and other visuals to track the information you need.

name: Method Raid Tools (MRT)
description_text: Method Raid Tools provides tools for raiders, raid leaders and officers. Its modules include raid cooldowns, notes, reminders, combat logs, raid inspection, attendance tracking, encounter statistics and group management.

name: NeedToKnow
description_text: NeedToKnow lets you monitor specific buffs, debuffs, cooldowns, and totems as timer bars that always appear in a consistent place on your screen.

name: TellMeWhen
description_text: TellMeWhen is a WoW addon that provides visual, auditory, and textual notifications about cooldowns, buffs, and pretty much every other element of combat.

name: BLT
description_text: BLT Raid Cooldowns tracks offensive and defensive raid cooldowns, announces their use and availability, and reports cooldown usage after boss fights. This version also supports trinket cooldowns.

name: OmniCC
description_text: Adds numeric cooldown timers to spells, abilities, and items, turning the default analog cooldown swirl into clear digital countdown text. Works with the default UI and most addons. Use /omnicc or /occ to open the options.

name: Raelis Spell Announcer
description_text: Raeli's Spell Announcer (RSA) announces selected spell casts in chat, including interrupts, defensive cooldowns and utility abilities such as Soulstone.

name: Tidy Plates
description_text: Tidy Plates customizes nameplates and displays information such as threat and health percentages.

name: NotPlater
description_text: NotPlater is a customizable nameplate AddOn inspired by Plater. It provides detailed threat information and configurable display options. Open its settings with the minimap button, /np or /notplater.

name: ElvUI
description_text: ElvUI is a complete Blizzard UI replacement with built-in unit frames, action bars and matching skins. It has a large selection of plugins, including features that are hard to find in standalone AddOns, making it a community favorite.

items.name: ElvUI_Extras
items.note: Download for ElvUI 6.09. AwesomeWotLK is recommended by the author.

items.name: ElvUI_ProjectZidras
items.note: Nameplate castbars require an HD client; see the plugin README.

items.name: ElvUI_ThreatImproved
items.note: Requires AwesomeWotLK. For use without AwesomeWotLK, choose ThreatImprovedLite below.

items.name: ElvUI_ThreatImprovedLite
items.note: Does not require AwesomeWotLK. Nameplate updates depend on mouseover and party or raid targets; see the plugin README.

items.name: ElvUI-Tweaker
items.note: Copy the main addon and its DataTexts, MiscTweaks and OptionsTweaks folders.

name: BlizzMove
description_text: This addon makes the Blizzard windows movable.

name: EventHorizon
description_text: EventHorizon displays your class and specialization's rotational abilities on a shared timeline, making it easier to see how their timings overlap.

name: ForteXorcist
description_text: ForteXorcist tracks damage-over-time effects on multiple targets and provides additional tools for warlocks and priests.

name: Dominos
description_text: Dominos replaces your main bar with movable parts that offer additional customization. It is used primarily for its action bars.

name: MoveAnything
description_text: MoveAnything enables you to move, scale, hide and adjust transparency of just about any screen element in WoW, offering tools to help you customize your UI.

name: Bartender4
description_text: Bartender4 replaces the default action bars with movable, customizable bars for your actions and related controls.

name: Raeli's Unit Frames
description_text: Raeli's Unit Frames (RUF) is a configurable unit-frame AddOn built on oUF.

name: Shadowed Unit Frames
description_text: Shadowed Unit Frames (SUF) provides customizable unit frames with range and aura indicators. Move and configure the frames to suit your layout.

name: SnowfallKeyPress
description_text:
SnowfallKeyPress makes keybindings activate when you press a key instead of when you release it.

⚠️ Do not use with ElvUI.

name: Grid2
description_text: Grid2 is a party/raid unit frame addon.

name: VuhDo
description_text: VuhDo displays party and raid members in customizable healing frames, making it easier to monitor their health.

name: Cell
description_text: Cell is a highly customizable party and raid frame addon with automatic layouts, built-in click-casting, aura and raid-debuff indicators, ready checks, death reports, and other raid tools. Open its options with /cell.

name: ClassicAPI
description_text: AddOn dependency required by the Tsoukie addons. ClassicAPI backports modern WoW API functions, templates, and systems so compatible addons can run on the 3.3.5a client. It is installed like a normal addon.

name: Compact Raid Frame
description_text: Compact Raid Frame brings the compact group frames from WoW Classic to 3.3.5a, with configurable layouts, sizes, class colors, profiles, and raid-management tools.

items.name: Enhanced Raid Frames
items.description_text: A Compact Raid Frame plugin that adds configurable aura indicators, range settings, frame scale and opacity controls, and target icons.

items.name: FrameSort
items.description_text: A Compact Raid Frame plugin that sorts units by group, role, or name; places or hides the player frame; adjusts spacing; and provides targeting keybinds and macro variables based on visual frame position.

items.name: BigDebuffs
items.description_text: BigDebuffs makes important crowd-control and defensive effects easier to see by placing duration icons on unit frames and enlarging priority debuffs on Compact Raid Frame.

name: Clique
description_text: Clique enables click-casting and mouseover casting on unit frames without requiring separate macros. Bind mouse buttons or key combinations directly to spells and use them on Compact Raid Frame and other supported unit frames.

name: BigDebuffs
description_text: BigDebuffs makes important crowd-control and defensive effects easier to see by placing duration icons on unit frames and enlarging priority debuffs on Compact Raid Frame.

name: OmniCD
description_text: OmniCD tracks party and raid members' spell and item cooldowns in real time. Its customizable icons and extra bars can attach to popular unit frames, including Compact Raid Frame.

name: Cooldowns
description_text: A World of Warcraft add-on that displays numeric cooldown counters on all buttons that are 28 pixels or wider.

name: Healbot
description_text: HealBot provides customizable healing bars with tools for healing, dispelling, buffing and resurrection. It also supports range checking and threat tracking.

name: AdiBags
description_text: AdiBags combines your bags into a single view and automatically groups items into categories using smart filters.

name: Bagnon Backport with Search and Sort Functionality
description_text: Bagnon combines your bags into a single interface with search and sorting features to help you find and organize items.

name: OmniInventory
description_text: OmniInventory combines your bags, bank, and guild bank in one searchable interface with category, list, and grid views. It also supports offline character inventories, sorting, item overlays, automatic junk selling, and repairs.

name: Decursive
description_text: Decursive helps classes with dispel abilities identify and remove harmful effects from group members.

name: Quartz
description_text: Quartz provides modular casting bars for tracking spell casts and channeling.

name: SexyCooldown
description_text: SexyCooldown is a single consolidated timer bar for all your spell, pet's spell, item, and proc cooldowns, as well as buffs, debuffs, and totem timers. It's very flexible, and can be customized to fit into your UI as best you see fit.

name: InspectEquip
description_text: InspectEquip adds a panel to the inspection window that groups equipment by its source, such as raids, vendors or crafting.

name: AllStats
description_text: AllStats shows all character statistics together in a panel beside the character window, replacing the default stat dropdowns.

name: OPie
description_text: OPie groups spells, items and other actions into radial rings. Hold a key or mouse binding to show a ring, move the cursor to an action and release the binding to use it.

name: Cheese
description_text: Cheese adds Cataclysm-style visual alerts for ability procs.

name: Mage Nuggets
description_text: Mage Nuggets provides tools for mages, including proc alerts, Polymorph tracking and a portal menu.

name: PallyPower Improved
description_text: PallyPower Improved helps paladins manage blessings, auras, seals and Righteous Fury through an interactive interface with indicators for missing buffs.

name: EclipseBar
description_text: EclipseBar displays a druid Eclipse bar whose marker follows the remaining Eclipse duration instead of a power value.

name: Outfitter
description_text: Outfitter lets you switch between equipment sets and supports weapon switching with DBM.

name: Postal+
description_text: Postal+ adds extra tools for managing your mailbox. This version includes additional features by BlueAo.

name: DrDamage
description_text: DrDamage calculates the damage or healing of your abilities, taking talents, gear and buffs into account. It displays the results on action buttons and adds detailed statistics to spellbook and action-bar tooltips.

name: MikScrollingBattleText(MSBT)
description_text: MikScrollingBattleText (MSBT) replaces Blizzard's floating combat text with configurable scrolling areas for damage, healing and other combat information.

name: xCT+
description_text: xCT+ replaces the default combat text with a configurable display backported from Mists of Pandaria. It includes in-game options for a cleaner, less cluttered layout.

name: ClassicNumbers
description_text: ClassicNumbers replaces the default floating damage text with the classic popping animation. It offers configurable size, transparency, duration, scroll speed, damage-school colors, number shortening, and filters for small hits and critical strikes. Open its options with /cn.

name: RaidBrowser for Warmane
description_text: RaidBrowser adds a working raid browser to the unused LFR tab in the social window for Warmane. Open it with /rb.

name: GroupBulletinBoard
description_text: GroupBulletinBoard organizes dungeon and group requests from chat into a filterable list, with optional sound and chat notifications. Open it with /gbb or the minimap icon.

name: AutoFlood
description_text: AutoFlood periodically posts a configured message to a chat channel, for example for guild recruitment, crafting services or events.

name: RaidBuffStatus
description_text: RaidBuffStatus checks raid readiness and reports missing buffs, consumables, low mana and AFK players through a configurable dashboard or group chat.

name: iTargetingFrames
description_text:
iTargetingFrames displays nameplate units in a clickable grid. It requires a client patched with AwesomeWotLK. If units appear more than once, use the modified DLL with fixed nameplate units provided by its repository.

Does not work on servers that do not support AwesomeWotLK features (e.g. Warmane).

name: RaidComp
description_text: RaidComp gives raid leaders an overview of their group composition and the buffs and debuffs it can provide, helping identify missing coverage.

name: KRT: Kader Raid Tools
description_text: KRT provides a collection of raid tools designed to help raid leaders manage their group.

name: Raid Roll
description_text: Raid Roll assigns an ID to each raid member, performs a roll and announces the winner. It can also track player rolls for dropped loot.

name: PhoenixStyle
description_text: PhoenixStyle tracks raid mistakes and other boss-fight information to help raid leaders review encounters.

name: GTFO: Stop standing in fire!
description_text: GTFO plays audible warnings when you stand in harmful effects, helping you react to avoidable damage in dungeons and raids.

name: RaidSlackCheck
description_text: RaidSlackCheck tracks raid potion use, missing flasks and food buffs, and buffs after a combat resurrection. It is a standalone part of PhoenixStyle.

name: EnsidiaFails
description_text: EnsidiaFails reports mistakes made by players during raid encounters.

name: AutoInvite
description_text: AutoInvite invites players to your party or raid when they use configured trigger words in selected chat channels. Open the options with /ai or /autoinvite.

name: AutoRepair
description_text: AutoRepair automatically repairs your equipment when you visit a merchant who can repair items.

name: ClassLoot
description_text: ClassLoot adds Kaliban's class and specialization ratings to raid-loot tooltips, helping you judge which characters an item suits.

name: RatingBuster
description_text: RatingBuster adds rating conversions, stat breakdowns, item-level information, and equipment comparisons directly to item tooltips.

name: HalionHelper
description_text: Provides a clearer visual display of the Corporeality buff during phase 3 of the Halion encounter in Ruby Sanctum. Similar to the PVP capture frame, this lets you easily see if you should be DPSing more, less, or the same.

name: DocsCorporeality(IMO better than HalionHelper)
description_text: DocsCorporeality helps you track Corporeality during phase 3 of the Halion encounter in Ruby Sanctum.

name: AutomaticWeaponRemoval
description_text: AutomaticWeaponRemoval can unequip melee weapons when you are mind-controlled during supported encounters. It also offers features such as removing Righteous Fury when you are not tanking. Configure it through the interface or /awr.

name: BattleGroundHealers
description_text: BattleGroundHealers detects healers in battlegrounds through combat-log activity and scoreboard healing-to-damage ratios, then marks their nameplates with a configurable icon. It supports default nameplates and most custom nameplate addons, and can share detection data with BattlegroundTargets. Use /bgh to open the configuration panel.

name: GladiusEx
description_text: GladiusEx adds customizable enemy unit frames for arenas, making targeting and focusing easier. Individual features can be enabled or disabled.

name: Gladdy
description_text: Gladdy provides customizable arena enemy frames with health, cooldown, diminishing-return, aura, cast-bar, and totem information for competitive PvP.

name: OmniBar
description_text: OmniBar tracks enemy spell cooldowns on one or more configurable bars, giving PvP players a clear view of when important interrupts, crowd control, and defensive abilities are available again.

name: InterruptBar
description_text: InterruptBar tracks enemy interrupt cooldowns on a compact bar.

name: LoseControl
description_text: LoseControl makes it easy to see the duration of crowd control spells by displaying them in a dedicated icon onscreen.

name: Afflicted
description_text: Afflicted tracks enemy spell cooldowns in PvP, especially arenas, so you can see when interrupts and other important abilities become available again.

name: SpellReplay
description_text: SpellReplay displays a scrolling history of recently used abilities, similar to TrufiGCD. The display speeds up when several spells are used together, making it useful for streams and gameplay reviews.

name: TrufiGCD
description_text: TrufiGCD displays recently used abilities for you, party members and arena players. It can also show your spell history on streams.

name: SoundAlerter
description_text: SoundAlerter plays audio alerts when enemies use important cooldowns, crowd control, defensive abilities and trinkets in PvP.

name: BindPad
description_text: BindPad lets you assign keybindings directly to spells, items and macros without placing them on action bars. Drag an action into a BindPad slot and click the slot to set its binding.

name: TipTac
description_text: TipTac customizes tooltips, including their position, font, size and scale.

name: BugSack
description_text: BugSack collects Lua errors and displays their full debug stacks, helping players and developers investigate AddOn problems.

name: SmartTrack
description_text: SmartTrack automatically selects hunter tracking based on your target's creature type when you enter combat or change targets. It is intended for hunters with the Improved Tracking talent.

name: Spy
description_text: Spy detects enemy players through combat-log activity and adds them to a nearby-player list. It can sound an alert and identify their class, race or level when that information can be inferred from their actions.

name: Vd-skip
description_text: Vd-skip is a lightweight addon that streamlines NPC interactions by automatically skipping unnecessary dialogue with vendors and flight masters.

name: Overachiever
description_text: Overachiever provides tools and tweaks to make the lives of players seeking achievements a little bit easier.

name: Ackis Recipe List
description_text: Ackis Recipe List is an AddOn which will scan your trade skills and provide information on how to obtain recipes.

name: RecipeColor
description_text: RecipeColor colors recipes your character already knows green in bags, banks, mail, trade, loot, and merchant frames. It also supports popular bag and UI addons including AdiBags, Bagnon, DragonUI, and ElvUI.

name: What's Training?
description_text: What's Training? adds a new spellbook tab that lists every trainable spell for your class. Spells are grouped into categories such as available now, missing requirements, coming soon, and not yet available, with the required level and total training cost shown at a glance.

name: Collectinator
description_text: Collectinator identifies missing companion pets and mounts and shows where to obtain them. Open your companion window and click the scan button.

name: Ludwig
description_text: Ludwig is an in-game item database with search and filtering options, making it easier to find items and compare their properties.

name: Improved Profession Capper
description_text: Improved Profession Capper suggests which recipes to craft next when leveling your professions. Its recommendations appear alongside the profession window.

name: Molinari
description_text: Molinari lets you perform supported item-processing actions directly from your bags by holding Alt and clicking an item, without opening the profession window or using a macro.

name: Redeemer
description_text: Redeemer sends humorous chat messages when you cast a resurrection spell.

name: AddEmote
description_text: AddEmote lets you create custom /command emotes for your characters. Open its settings with /addemote.

name: Immersion
description_text: Immersion replaces the default quest and NPC dialogue windows with a more immersive interface.

name: Unified Profile Manager
description_text: Manage all your AceDB-based addon profiles from one single interface. Open it with /profiles or /upm to view, switch, copy, and clean up profiles across addons and characters, all in one compact list.

name: Storyline
description_text: Storyline replaces the quest window with an immersive dialogue interface featuring animated 3D character models and visual effects.

name: Altoholic
description_text: Altoholic keeps information about your other characters in one place, including their bags, mail, auctions, professions and other character details, so you can check it without logging between characters.

name: Key Bind Profiles
description_text: Key Bind Profiles saves keybindings in profiles that you can load later. Profiles can be assigned to specializations and loaded automatically when you switch specs. Use /kbp help for commands.

name: Action Bar Saver 2
description_text: Action Bar Saver 2 saves action-bar layouts for spells, macros and items in named profiles. Use /abs save name to save a layout and /abs restore name to restore it.

name: MacroBank
description_text: MacroBank is an addon that allows you to easily create, organize, and save macros for future use without needing to first create them in the game's default macro window. It offers features like categorizing macros, editing text and icons, loading and replacing macros, and even sending macros to other MacroBank users.

name: SharedMedia AddOns
description_text:
SharedMedia packs add fonts, status-bar textures, borders and sounds to LibSharedMedia for use by compatible AddOns.

bKader Shared Media: Additional bar textures, fonts, sounds and other custom media.
MerfinPlus: Predefined text-to-speech sounds, status bars, fonts and other media.
SharedMedia Retail: Additional bar textures and fonts from the retail media pack.
SharedMediaAdditionalFonts: Additional fonts.

name: Color Picker Advanced
description_text: Color Picker Advanced replaces the default color picker with class-color presets and copy-and-paste support.

name: MogIt
description_text: MogIt is an in-game catalogue of items with the aim of helping players build their own sets for transmogrification purposes.

name: Atlas
description_text: Atlas provides detailed dungeon and raid maps with markers for bosses, entrances and other points of interest.

name: Equipence
description_text: Displays gems, enchants, item levels, and quality borders directly in the character and inspection UI. See full gear status at a glance without extra steps. All visual elements can be toggled or adjusted in the options.

name: MoP Item Tooltips
description_text: MoP Item Tooltips changes item tooltips to match the appearance of later expansions.

name: PlateBuffs
description_text: PlateBuffs displays buffs and debuffs above enemy nameplates, helping you track important auras in PvP and combat. This version is based on Kader's backport and adds improved spell filtering, duration text options, expiration animations, nameplate tracking, and simulated interrupt debuffs.

name: DressMe
description_text: DressMe lets you preview item appearances and create and save character looks.

name: DragonUI
description_text: DragonUI is a modular, retail-inspired UI addon. It includes customizable action bars, unit frames, castbars, XP and reputation bars, chat enhancements, a retail-style minimap, bag sorting, layout presets, editor mode, and profile support.

name: CartoMapper
description_text: CartoMapper combines map reveal, zooming, coordinates, group icons, points of interest, waypoints, instance maps and battlefield-minimap enhancements in one AddOn for WotLK 3.3.5a.

name: Leatrix Maps
description_text: Leatrix Maps enhances the world map with a movable borderless window, opacity controls, coordinates, zone and fishing levels, points of interest, quest objectives, map reveal, and configurable zoom and panning. Open its options with /ltm.

name: Leatrix Plus
description_text: Leatrix Plus provides a collection of optional quality-of-life improvements for quests, gossip, summons, resurrection, vendors, chat, frames, text, and other interface systems. Open its configuration with /ltp.

name: DialogUI
description_text: An immersive quest / gossip / book dialog UI for World of Warcraft 3.3.5a.

name: Soulstone
description_text: Move your setup to another character, realm or server: action bars (all 120 slots, both specs), character macros, keybindings (incl. Bartender4), talents and glyphs. Includes talent templates with Wowhead import/export, a visual preview and an automatic backup before every restore.

name: Warperia App
description_text: Warperia is an AddOn manager for World of Warcraft private servers, including WotLK 3.3.5a. Browse, install and update AddOns, import them from GitHub and manage multiple game folders in one app. Available for Windows 10+ and Linux, with no account required.

name: AddOn Update Tool
description_text:
Updates World of Warcraft AddOns hosted on GitHub or GitLab. The provided config.yaml lists AddOns from this repository and can be extended with your own entries.

How to install:
1. Back up your Interface folder.
2. Download and extract the AddOns Update Tool into your WoW folder.
3. Place the provided config.yaml in the same WoW folder.
4. Run the updater to update the configured AddOns.
